hero.title: Welcome to Book Inventory
hero.description: Manage stock, orders, billing and ledgers in one place.

features.earningsDescription: Follow books and stationery from purchase to sale.
features.securityDescription: See every school and vendor ledger with a full statement.
features.supportDescription: The admin team is always one message away.
